use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

claims.content: To exchange surveillance information on the Link 16 network using fixed format messages, including IFF/SIF data for tracks.

goal.raw_text: To exchange surveillance information on the Link 16 network using fixed format messages, including IFF/SIF data for tracks.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU is participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages.
Surveillance information, including track data (Air, Surface, Subsurface, Land, Space, or EW), has been identified or generated by the system.

The C2 JU has locally entered IFF/SIF data that changes from zero to nonzero or nonzero to another nonzero value, or receives a J7.5 (ACT = 1) Difference Report message indicating different ID/Environment/Category data.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU has locally entered IFF/SIF data that changes from zero to nonzero or nonzero to another nonzero value, or receives a J7.5 (ACT = 1) Difference Report message indicating different ID/Environment/Category data.

claims.content: The C2 JU (with R²) reports all IFF/SIF valid data locally held for that track in accordance with the transmit rules for the J3 messages.

The C2 JU determines validity of codes for established tracks as either 'Valid Data' or 'No Data' based on criteria: No Data if no valid code is currently held; Valid Data if received from own sensors on two or more successive interrogations for Modes I, II, and III with same value, one interrogation for Mode IV, manually entered codes, or codes accepted per Table 4.7-5.

The C2 JU transmits IFF/SIF surveillance data in J3.2C1 and J3.3C1 words for Air and Surface tracks respectively, periodically at 1/8 the basic message rate for realtime tracks and with each NRT track report.
Any change in IFF/SIF code values from No Data to Valid Data or between Valid Data values is reported as occurring by the C2 JU.

If the C2 JU receives a J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message initiated by operator action, it automatically sets designated mode(s) for specified track to No Data status (except Mode IV may be automatic or operator-determined).

Upon receiving or initiating a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message resulting in no IFF/SIF data being held on the track, the C2 JU shall not continue transmitting the periodic J3 message that includes the continuation word containing IFF/SIF data.

When reporting on the Surveillance NPG, if the C2 JU obtains target position via J12.6 Target Sorting message from a non-C² JU, it initially assigns TQ value per Table 4.4-7 and extrapolates received target’s position to time of transmission unless local sensor data has been correlated for the track.

If a C2 JU without R² receives a J3 message that includes a continuation word with remote IFF/SIF data or a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message differing from locally held data, it shall respond as indicated in Table 4.7-5.
If a C2 JU receives a J7.5 (ACT = 0) Mode IV Clear message, acceptance or rejection may be automatic or by operator determination.
If a C2 JU changes a local mode to a No Data status, it may do so without transmitting a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message.
IFF/SIF surveillance data has been exchanged, with the JU with R² assumed to be reporting the most current data available in the interface.
All receiving JUs have accepted any alert indicators (EMG IND or FT IND) set by an FJU in their databases.

For tracks where a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message resulted in no IFF/SIF data being held, the periodic J3 message containing the continuation word with IFF/SIF data is no longer transmitted by the JU with R².
Track information on the interface is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible, with data correlated and dual designation minimized.
